# Toto

> Toto is the official European red fox mascot of Spanish Total.js: identity, transparent artwork, reusable face icons and a bilingual static presentation.

Limited-use license for the Total.js community: apps, sites and services showing Toto must state they were built with Total.js and link to totaljs.com or totaljs.es; public access does not grant an open asset license. English is the default (README.md, LICENSE.md, docs/); Spanish is in README.es.md, LICENSE.es.md and docs/es/. Node.js 18+ runs the local checks without dependencies. Artwork and trademark metadata describe this repository, not external verification.

## Start here

- [Meet Toto](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/toto/main/README.md): English introduction and collection previews
- [Hola, soy Toto](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/toto/main/README.es.md): Spanish introduction and collection previews
- [Agent guidance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/toto/main/AGENTS.md): Repository map, visual invariants, source files and commands
- [AI kit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/toto/main/docs/ai.md): Assistant entry points, shared workflows and verification scope
## Identity and use

- [His story](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/toto/main/docs/story.md): Origins and character narrative
- [Identity guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/toto/main/docs/identity.md): Species, visual features, palette and tone
- [Pose integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/toto/main/docs/poses.md): Stable IDs, assets, HTML and Total.js examples with the Built with Total.js notice
- [Face icons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/toto/main/docs/favicon.md): Reusable favicon kit and integration
- [Trademark details](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/toto/main/docs/trademark.md): Locally recorded mark information and registry reference
- [License](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/totaljs-es/toto/main/LICENSE.md): Limited-use terms for the Total.js community
